```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(AICcmodavg)
library(patchwork)
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 18)) #for ggplot

```

```{r}
primula <- read.csv(here("clean_data", "Primula_Demography_Data_CLEANED_2016thru2026.csv"))
climate <- read.csv(here("clean_data", "CGOP_climatevalues_scaled.csv"))
climate<- climate %>%
  arrange(year) %>%
  mutate(across(-year, ~lag(.x), .names = "prev_{.col}")) %>% 
  select(c(year, winter.mean.min.temp, prev_winter.mean.min.temp, summer.mean.max.temp, prev_summer.mean.max.temp, spring.mean.temp, prev_spring.mean.temp, fall.mean.temp, prev_fall.mean.temp, ends_with("tot.precip")))
primula <- left_join(primula, climate)
primula <- primula %>% 
  filter(year!= "2016") %>% 
  group_by(tag) %>% 
  mutate(year = as.factor(year), 
    plot = as.factor(plot),
    psurvival = factor(psurvival, levels = c(0, 1)),
    psurvivalT1 = as.character(psurvivalT1),
    psurvivalT1 = factor(psurvivalT1, levels = c(0, 1)),
    pflower = factor(pflower, levels = c(0, 1)),
    pflowerT1 = factor(pflowerT1, levels = c(0, 1)),
    pclonal = factor(pclonal, levels = c(0, 1)),
    log.ros.area.prev = log(ros.areaTminus1),
    trt = as.factor(trt),
    trt = fct_relevel(trt, "irrigated", "control", "drought")) 
primula.surv <- primula %>% 
  filter(!year %in% c("2025", "2026"),
  !is.na(psurvivalT1))
clonal <- primula %>% 
  filter(log.ros.area>0,
         !is.na(no.neighbors)&!is.na(pclonal),
        !year  == "2026")
leaf <- primula %>% 
  filter(log.ros.area>0,
         no.smleaf>0,
         !is.na(no.neighbors),
         no.smleaf<15)
```

```{r growth prequel}
base <- lmer(log.ros.areaT1 ~ log.ros.area*year + (1|plot), data = primula, REML = F)
drop1(base,test="Chisq") #yes interaction us significant
# base2 <- lmer(log.ros.areaT1 ~ log.ros.area+year + (1|plot), data = primula, REML = F)
# base3 <- lmer(log.ros.areaT1 ~ log.ros.area+ (1|plot), data = primula, REML = F)
# a2 <- anova(base3, base2, test="LRT") #yes year is significant
growth.base <- lmer(log.ros.areaT1 ~ log.ros.area + (1|plot) + (1|year), data = primula, REML = F)

re_year <- rownames_to_column(
  as.data.frame(ranef(growth.base)$year),
  var = "year") %>% 
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year)) %>% 
  rename(int = `(Intercept)`)
# 
grow.corr <- left_join(re_year, climate, by = "year") %>% 
  select(-year)

cor_results <- lapply( names(grow.corr), function(v) {
  test <- cor.test(grow.corr$int, grow.corr[[v]])
  data.frame(
    variable = v,
    correlation = test$estimate,
    p_value = test$p.value
  )
})

cor_results_growth <- do.call(rbind, cor_results)
cor_results_growth <- cor_results_growth[order(-abs(cor_results_growth$correlation)), ]
#fall.tot.precip
#spring.mean.temp

```

```{r growth}
gm.base <- lmer(log.ros.areaT1 ~ log.ros.area + (1|plot) + (1|year), data = primula, REML = F)
gm.t <-  lmer(log.ros.areaT1 ~ log.ros.area + trt + (1|plot) + (1|year), data = primula, REML = F)
gm.ti <-  lmer(log.ros.areaT1 ~ log.ros.area*trt + (1|plot) + (1|year), data = primula, REML = F)

gm.st.ti <-  lmer(log.ros.areaT1 ~ log.ros.area+trt*spring.mean.temp + (1|plot) + (1|year), data = primula, REML = F)
gm.st.ti2 <-  lmer(log.ros.areaT1 ~ log.ros.area*trt+spring.mean.temp + (1|plot) + (1|year), data = primula, REML = F)
gm.st.ti3 <-  lmer(log.ros.areaT1 ~ log.ros.area*trt*spring.mean.temp + (1|plot) + (1|year), data = primula, REML = F)

gm.fp <-  lmer(log.ros.areaT1 ~ log.ros.area + fall.tot.precip + (1|plot) + (1|year), data = primula, REML = F)

gm.fp.t <-  lmer(log.ros.areaT1 ~ log.ros.area+trt+fall.tot.precip + (1|plot) + (1|year), data = primula, REML = F)
gm.fp.ti <-  lmer(log.ros.areaT1 ~ log.ros.area+trt*fall.tot.precip + (1|plot) + (1|year), data = primula, REML = F)
gm.fp.ti2 <-  lmer(log.ros.areaT1 ~ log.ros.area*trt+fall.tot.precip + (1|plot) + (1|year), data = primula, REML = F)
gm.fp.ti3 <-  lmer(log.ros.areaT1 ~ log.ros.area*trt*fall.tot.precip + (1|plot) + (1|year), data = primula, REML = F)

growth <- mget(ls(pattern = "^gm"))
g_AICc<-aictab(cand.set = growth,second.ord=TRUE,nobs=NULL,sort=TRUE)
#gm.st.i
#rm(list = ls(pattern = "^surv\\."))
```

```{r growth figure}
pred.dat.g <- expand.grid(log.ros.area = seq(min(primula$log.ros.area, na.rm = TRUE), max(primula$log.ros.area, na.rm = TRUE), by = .1), spring.mean.temp = c(1, -1))
pred.dat.output.g <- cbind(pred.dat.g, as.data.frame(predict(gm.st.i, newdata = pred.dat.g, type="response", re.form=~0, pred.var=TRUE)))
colnames(pred.dat.output.g)[ncol(pred.dat.output.g)] <- "log.ros.areaT1"  # Renaming the last column

(growth.fig <- primula %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = log.ros.area, y = log.ros.areaT1))+
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, shape = 1) +
  geom_line(data = pred.dat.output.g, aes(color = factor(spring.mean.temp)),linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_abline(slope=1, intercept = 0, color= "grey", linewidth = .2)+
  theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = 'black', linewidth = 1.1), legend.position = c(0.25, .9),   legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = NA),
  legend.key = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = NA))+
  geom_abline(slope=1, intercept = 0, color= "grey", linewidth = .4)+
  scale_color_manual(name = "Spring mean temp in t", values = c("#00a3a3","#d72a96"), labels = c("cool", "warm")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 6))+
  labs( x = "log(Rosette Area) in t", y = "log(Rosette Area) in t + 1", linetype = "Temp.", color = "")+
  scale_x_continuous( limits = c(0, 6), breaks = seq(0, 6, by = 1), expand = c(0, 0)))
ggsave(here("Figures", "Primula", "growth.png"), plot = growth.fig, width = 6, height =6)
```

```{r pflower prequel}
table(primula$year, primula$pflower)
pflow.base <- glmer(pflower ~ log.ros.area.prev + (1|plot) + (1|year), data = subset(primula, year != "2017"), family = "binomial")
base.p <- glmer(pflower ~ log.ros.area.prev*year + (1|plot), data = subset(primula, year != "2017"), family = "binomial", control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 10000)))
drop1(base.p,test="Chisq") 

re_year <- rownames_to_column(
  as.data.frame(ranef(pflow.base)$year),
  var = "year") %>% 
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year))%>% 
  rename(int = `(Intercept)`)

pflower.corr <- left_join(re_year, climate) %>% 
  select(-year)

# get correlations and p-values
cor_results <- lapply(names(pflower.corr), function(v) {
  test <- cor.test(pflower.corr$int, pflower.corr[[v]])
  data.frame(
    variable = v,
    correlation = test$estimate,
    p_value = test$p.value
  )
})
cor_results_pflower <- do.call(rbind, cor_results)

# Sort by absolute correlation
cor_results_pflower <- cor_results_pflower[order(-abs(cor_results_pflower$correlation)), ]
```

```{r probabilty of clones}
probc2 <- glmer(pclonal ~ log.ros.area + (1|plot) + (1|year), data = clonal, family = "binomial")
probc3 <- glmer(pclonal ~ log.ros.area + trt+ (1|plot) + (1|year), data = clonal, family = "binomial")
probc4 <- glmer(pclonal ~ log.ros.area*trt+ (1|plot) + (1|year), data = clonal, family = "binomial")

pclone <- mget(ls(pattern = "^probc"))
pclone_AICc<-aictab(cand.set = pclone,second.ord=TRUE,nobs=NULL,sort=TRUE)

pclone_AICc <- pclone_AICc %>% 
  arrange(AICc) %>% 
  slice_head(n = 10)
pclone_AICc$vitalrate <- "pclonal"
#AIC.save <- bind_rows(AIC.save, pclone_AICc)
```

```{r probability of clones figure}

pred.dat.pc <- expand.grid(log.ros.area = seq(0, max(primula$log.ros.area, na.rm = TRUE), by = .1))
pred.dat.output.pc <- cbind(pred.dat.pc, as.data.frame(predict(probc2, newdata = pred.dat.pc, type="response", re.form=~0, pred.var=TRUE)))
colnames(pred.dat.output.pc)[ncol(pred.dat.output.pc)] <- "pclonal"  # Renaming the last column


(pc.fig <- ggplot(subset(primula, log.ros.area>0), aes(x = log.ros.area, y = as.numeric(pclonal) - 1))+
  geom_jitter(alpha= 0.2, shape = 1, height = .075)+
  geom_line(data = pred.dat.output.pc, aes(x = log.ros.area, y = pclonal), linewidth = 1.15)+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 6), breaks = seq(0, 6, by = 1), expand = c(0, 0))+
      theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = 'black', linewidth = 1.1),
        text = element_text(size = 20))+ 
      labs(y = "P(clonal) in t", x = "log(Rosette Area) in t"))

ggsave(here("Figures", "Primula", "pclonal.png"), plot = pc.fig, width = 6, height =6)

```
